¶ Standards · I–V

Editorial Standards

I

Sources We Cite

  • Academic databases: PubMed, Cochrane, SSRN, NBER
  • Government data: BLS, FDA, EPA, FTC, CFPB, NHTSA
  • Industry standards: AVMA, AAFCO, NIST, ISO, IEEE
  • Manufacturer official specifications
  • Verified measurement publications: RTINGS, Wirecutter

II

Sources We Avoid

  • Wikipedia article body (acceptable as discovery for primary sources)
  • Other blogs, personal testimonials
  • Influencer reviews
  • Vendor marketing material (specifications excepted)

III

Corrections Policy

Errors are corrected within 24 hours of discovery. Updates are logged inline as "Updated YYYY-MM-DD: [change]".

IV

Sponsorship Policy

We never accept payment for recommendations. Affiliate fees are disclosed at the top of each article and in the footer.

V

AI Usage Policy

All articles are produced with AI assistance. All primary sources are verified by humans before publication.
